description: Remove one address from the waitlist of a site that SHIP made, for example when a visitor asks to be deleted. Give the address as email. Add entryId from list_site_waitlist to remove that entry only while it still holds the address. When nothing matches, the call fails with site_waitlist_entry_not_found and nothing changes. The address leaves the live list at once. The database's recovery history keeps it for up to 30 days, then it is gone, and SHIP does not restore single addresses. The call needs the site-waitlist:write scope and an owner or an admin of the workspace, and the audit log records each removal.

email.description: The address to remove; upper and lower case do not matter

entryId.description: The id of the entry, from list_site_waitlist. With it, the call removes that entry only while it still holds the address

name: remove_site_waitlist_entry
title: Remove site waitlist entry
